prompt: A monochrome silverpoint character study: a single figure alone on plain off-white paper, drawn only in fine grey metalpoint lines and hatching. A gaunt, deathly woman whose face is drawn so tight over the bone that it reads as a skull, with hollow cheeks, deep eye sockets and thin, wispy hair, crowned with a wreath of field flowers. Her mouth hangs slack and far too wide, and a long tongue lolls out and down over her chest. Her eyes are blank white in deep sockets. She is fully clothed, covered from neck to ankle in a tattered, decaying, long-sleeved peasant dress, and her bony, withered hands hold a curved sickle. Full-length figure: the whole body from head to feet inside the frame, isolated on blank paper. silverpoint study, metalpoint drawing, bestiary illustration, hatching and cross-hatching, fine line, high contrast, sharp focus, monochrome, clean light paper ground
